scope: One native scene and one process profiler; three sequential manual RUM views. This is process-profile correlation evidence, not simultaneous-window or per-scene CPU evidence.

required_environment.native: Supported physical iOS device with profiling conditions satisfied
required_environment.backend: Authenticated RUM and Continuous Profiler access
required_environment.host: Opt-in scene lifecycle in the existing BenchmarkTests runner; ordinary benchmark build unchanged

identity.installation: Clean install; missing preexisting data container; hash installed executable against built executable
identity.restoration: Reject an existing receipt path; never reuse run identity

native_assertions: Fresh externally supplied run identity and committed source identity
Exactly one connected native scene with an attached visible window
StartA mapper owner and actual TTID message observed before starting work
First Operation start message has StartA owner and key A
StartB is a fresh mapper owner and StartA is ended before starting B
Second Operation start has StartB owner, key B and a distinct start ID
Finish is a third fresh mapper owner and StartB is ended before completion
First end message has key B and Finish owner before the later A end
Second end message has key A and Finish owner
Exactly four distinct step IDs, one RUM session and the frozen name/key/step order
Exactly three final inactive fixture views plus one inactive built-in ApplicationLaunch view; four distinct IDs in one session
Observed start/end dates produce two positive durations with A greater than B
backend_assertions: Query the full RUM session and profile time range/service; validate all run identities rather than filtering away stale owners
Join each of four RUM steps to the native observed exact Vital ID, key, step, session and view
One matching custom profile contains both exact start IDs, matching operation names and actual observed server-offset start_ns and duration_ns
The profile has nonempty native wall-time stack samples; a native testing stub or simulator cannot close T14
Profile labels describe the final process context, not independent per-view CPU ownership
Inventory unexpected profiles/events explicitly; preserve any built-in app-launch telemetry separately and admit no additional fixture Operation
controls: end ID substituted for start ID
native assertion recorded after its critical boundary
fractional native duration and plus/minus one nanosecond rejection
limits: Actual OS/device profile upload and backend attachment visibility remain required
No simultaneous topology or scene-specific CPU claim
Simulator fixture checks establish mechanics only
No SDK production, API, dependency, networking-format or existing build-script change
native_clock_conversion: Double seconds multiplied by 1e9, rounded to nearest with ties away from zero, matching Int64.ddWithNoOverflow; exact integer comparison, no tolerance
